how: scripts/verify/doorwalk.mjs (eye shots) and a route-shot script on the same launcher; python scripts/serve.py 8711; VERIFY_GL=hardware; ?walk=1&drift=0&intro=0; window.cancelGraphicsAutoDetect() called; waited for #veil to go and for austin-entrances to be source-loaded before every frame; screenshot taken twice, second kept
eyeAltitudeNote: eye altitude read back off window.__fly.eye() AFTER the jump, not requested and assumed. controls.js pins ZOOM_MAX 21.5, so below ~18 m of standoff the derived zoom saturates and the app's own floor is ~2.23 m rather than the requested 1.70 m. That floor is reported, not fought.
